name: codemonster-ui-devtools
description: Standalone CodeMonster tools for source highlighting and Vue previews.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codemonster-ru/ui-playground-core && npm run build -w @codemonster-ru/ui-playground-vite-plugin && npm run build -w @codemonster-ru/ui-codeblock && npm run build -w @codemonster-ru/ui-playground
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm test --workspaces
